card.name: Be/is before "suspected" in conditionals
card.fires_on: The helper verb "be" or "is" right before "suspected" in an if/should clause, such as "If pancreatitis is suspected" or "Should a stroke occur or be suspected".

modes.label: Should ... occur or be
modes.description: "be" after "occur or" in a should-clause about a stroke or clotting event, before "suspected".
modes.example: Should a stroke occur or<< be>> suspected, estrogen-alone therapy should be discontinued

modes.label: If condition is suspected
modes.description: "is" after a named condition such as pancreatitis in an if-clause, before "suspected".
modes.example: If pancreatitis<< is>> suspected, SAXENDA should promptly be

card.writes: It suppresses words like seem, seems, perceived, so it steers the model away from "seem" words and toward "suspected".
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before "suspected" in warnings like "if pancreatitis is suspected".
